problem: The user asked for a panel to tune model parameters, temperature above all. There was none: grep -rniE 'temperature|top_p|top_k|num_ctx' found nothing in aries/settings/ or aries/intelligence/; the only sampling values were three literals inside OllamaProvider.generate (temperature 0.1, num_ctx 8192, num_predict from max_tokens). The gateway's Generate model is Strict with extra='forbid', so they could not just be added to the request body: the running aries-local-model.service answered 422 extra_forbidden to a body carrying temperature.
change: Four typed settings in aries/settings/defaults.py under ai.*: temperature (0.0-2.0, default 0.1), top_p (0.05-1.0, default 0.9), context_tokens (512-32768, default 8192, user_only because raising it reloads the model and costs VRAM), max_output_tokens (256-4096, default 4096). Every default is the literal it replaced, so no output changes until a slider moves. generation.config() fetches them in one get_many; a new generation.sampling() returns the tuned triple plus min(caller budget, ai.max_output_tokens), a ceiling that can only lower what a caller asked for; local_generate threads them into the gateway body and the direct fallback alike. providers.py takes them as keyword arguments whose defaults are the old literals; OllamaProvider maps them onto options.temperature/top_p/num_ctx/num_predict, OpenAICompatibleProvider sends temperature/top_p only when given (it is also the cloud adapter). server.py accepts the three as optional bounded fields falling back to ai.*, so the gateway's own /route, /classify and /extract honour the panel too.
validation: tests/test_model_parameters.py 34 checks ALL PASSED, plus test_settings.py and test_intelligence.py green. Settings came from a throwaway harness sqlite file; live var/aries.db still holds 0 ai.* rows, 34 in all. Live measurements through the restarted gateway on ollama 0.34.0 + qwen2.5:7b. Temperature 0.0: two runs byte-identical ('The sea is a vast expanse of saltwater that covers over 70% of the Earth's surface...'); 1.8: four runs, four different sentences, none the greedy one. At 1.8, top_p 1.0 gives 3 distinct of 3 and top_p 0.05 gives 1 of 3, collapsing onto the greedy sentence. Raw-runtime control with a fixed seed: top_p omitted equals top_p 0.9 exactly and differs from 0.1, confirming 0.9 is the runtime's own default, so the new default sends nothing new in effect. ai.context_tokens 4096 made ollama launch llama-server with -c 4096 and /api/ps report context_length 4096; 8192 restored it. A 256 ceiling on a long prompt raised exactly ValueError('Model exhausted output budget'); a short answer completed at 2 tokens. The calibrated bare-enum path, re-measured afterwards, is unchanged at 67 ms.
limitations: ai.context_tokens cannot be honoured by the openai-compatible local backend: no request field exists, so it is accepted and ignored, and there temperature becomes explicitly sent (0.1) where the engine default applied before; on the live ollama backend nothing changes. ai.temperature does not reach aries/workspace/memory/calibration.py, which calls ollama /api/generate directly with temperature 0 hardcoded to read a posterior off the logits; that is deliberate and the 68 ms calibrated-enum finding depends on it. Measured risk on structured paths: at temperature 1.8 with a JSON schema the grammar keeps output parseable 3/3 but only 2/3 satisfy the Decision schema, the failure being a well-formed '"confidence": 95' outside 0-1, and the intent wandered (SYSTEM_ACTION for a research request); router.route() fails closed, so a high temperature costs routing reliability, not safety. Greedy decoding is repeatable only on a warm slot: on the bare runtime call 1 after a cold prompt cache differs and calls 2-6 are byte-identical — llama.cpp batch/KV numerics, not the setting. aries-local-model.service was restarted to load the new request model; aries-core.service was not, so the Settings app will not list the knobs until it is.
